LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Title.Details: Publish to Steam Workshop - Main Details
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Title: Title
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.Tip: "Uploaded commit" refers to the last commit that this mod could detect during a workshop publish.\n"Current commit" is the commit that the mod has detected right now and which would be set as the "uploaded commit" once you finish publishing.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.LastCommit.Hint: The last commit that has been published to the steam workshop. Must be the short hash, so 6 characters exactly.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.Preview: Changelog preview. You can edit this preview on the next page.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.NoGitRepository: No git repository found, cannot automatically generate changelog.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.OverwriteStartComm: Allows you to define a "starting point" for the commit list manually. The mod tracks the latest commit hash whenever you push to the workshop to fill this value automatically.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Commits.CommitNotInList: Commit hash could not be found in commit list. Clicking Overwrite will do nothing.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.ChangeLog.Info: Text entered here will be entered into the changelog on the steam workshop after a successful push.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Regex.Title: Regex Patterns
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Included: File or Directory is currently included in upload.\nClick to remove it from the workshop upload.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Excluded: File or Directory is currently excluded from upload.\nClick to add it to the workshop upload.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Partial: File or Directory is partially included in upload.\nClick to add or remove it from the workshop upload.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.Title: Publisher Plus
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.UseRelativePathTo: Display just the file / folder name instead of the full path relative to the mods root directory
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.ShowFileSize: Show file/directory size in file tree
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.IndentButtonsWith: Indent buttons with file tree depth

Moves the buttons in accordance to the file entries directory depth. If you want to have a "vertical line" of buttons all stacked neatly on top of each other instead of relatively positioned buttons, disable this
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.EmulateGitNotInst: Emulate git not installed / hide commit page
Can be used to disable the commit-page of the upload process.
LanguageData.PublisherPlus.Settings.GitLogCommand.Tip: Can be modified if you want to change the max count of commits to consider for user presentation.\n\nThere are no checks on the validity and parsability of this command here. Changing this in fundamental ways will break the logic to pull commits from your current project, so be careful.
